text.arabic_uthmani: وَءَاتَىٰكُم مِّن كُلِّ مَا سَأَلْتُمُوهُ ۚ وَإِن تَعُدُّوا۟ نِعْمَتَ ٱللَّهِ لَا تُحْصُوهَآ ۗ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لَظَلُومٌۭ كَفَّارٌۭ

words.gloss_range: ayah-opening connector that continues the prior provision catalogue and launches its summary gift claim
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) makes the ayah begin as continuation, not a detached start. It carries the prior divine-action chain into the giving verb and lets the new clause feel like a culminating restart: the cosmic services just named are gathered into one human-facing grant.

topics.headline: opening connector continues and summarizes prior provision
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah opens by carrying forward the prior provision sequence rather than beginning a separate topic.
topics.reason: The particle is a coordinating/proclitic connector before the giving verb, and the clause follows the prior divine provision sequence.

words.gloss_range: completed divine giving to the addressed plural; Form IV frames provision as caused arrival or delivered benefit
words.root_gloss_range: coming, arriving, bringing, giving, and in other settings committing an act; the local Form IV selects caused arrival as giving
words.prose: {{ar:ءَاتَىٰكُمْ}} ({{tr:ʾātākum}}) states the grant as already accomplished before any counting attempt begins, with the recipients carried inside the verb by the attached plural object. Form IV turns the root of coming into caused arrival: provision is made to reach the addressees. The carried divine subject and the boundary with the previous ayah make this the hinge from managed cosmos to delivered benefit.

topics.headline: completed giving with recipients inside the verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that human recipienthood is built into the completed giving verb before human asking or counting appears.
topics.reason: QAC identifies a perfect 3ms Form IV verb with a 2mp object suffix, and attachment evidence makes the suffix the direct object.

topics.headline: Form IV caused-arrival pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the giving is felt as provision caused to arrive, while the local form keeps giving as the selected sense.
topics.reason: The root range includes coming and arrival, but the local Form IV and object suffix select giving as caused arrival toward recipients.

topics.headline: boundary hinge from cosmic management to gift
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb recasts the previous cosmic subjugation scene as benefit delivered to humans.
topics.reason: The implicit divine subject is recovered from the prior sequence, and same-surah provision rows treat this verb as the summary beat of that chain.

words.gloss_range: preposition governing the provision-domain as partitive, source, or explanatory scope rather than a destination
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) makes the gift pass through a governed domain: from every requested field, not simply an unbounded object. Its partitive and explanatory pressures both matter, because the wording can sound comprehensive while still preventing the claim that every possible thing was transferred whole. That requested field also points back to the previous ayah's concrete provision domains, so the preposition indexes displayed gifts while keeping the clause scoped.

topics.headline: partitive and source scope of the gift
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the preposition controls how comprehensive the gift sounds: provision comes from every requested domain without becoming a crude claim of total transfer.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence show the preposition governing the following genitive scope noun; the row family preserves both partitive and explicative pressure.

topics.headline: prior provision domains are indexed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the prepositional phrase points back to the provision domains already displayed in the previous ayah.
topics.reason: The prepositional phrase sits directly after the giving verb and before the relative clause, so it frames the following request field as a provision-domain.

words.gloss_range: governed construct totality bound to the following request clause, with accepted variant pressure around how independent the scope is
words.root_gloss_range: totality and encompassing, with related weariness, dulling, and encircling imagery; the local noun selects totality while those images press on the failed count

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: preposition governing the gift's partitive or source scope

words.prose: {{ar:كُلِّ}} ({{tr:kulli}}) totalizes only through its construction: it is governed by {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) and bound to the following request field, so the scope is not a floating everything. The accepted tanwīn variant exposes the pressure point by allowing a more independent totality, while the canonical construct keeps the totality grammatically tethered. Root-family images of encircling and weariness make the total field feel like the very domain that exhausts human counting.

topics.headline: construct-bound totality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that totality is grammatically bound to the request clause rather than left as an abstract unlimited claim.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as genitive construct before the relative pronoun, and attachment evidence makes it the complement governed by the preceding preposition.

topics.headline: accepted variant exposes scope pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the canonical construct reading is deliberate because a variant shape could make totality more self-contained.
topics.reason: The variant pressure is useful for scope, but the local canonical surface remains construct-bound.

topics.headline: totality shaded by encircling and weariness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the total domain is not only large; it is the kind of encompassed whole that wears out the counter.
topics.reason: The local sense remains totality, while root-family derivatives supply encircling and weariness pressure relevant to the later failed enumeration.

topics.headline: pivot from abundance to incalculability
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this totality word is the hinge between given abundance and the next clause where counting breaks down.
topics.reason: The row family places the word at the structural transition from the provision scope to the inability-to-count clause.

words.gloss_range: relative pronoun defining the totality as what was asked, with maṣdar pressure around the act of asking

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: construct totality bound to the following request field

words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) is the hinge that prevents the totality from floating free: it ties {{ar:كُلِّ}} ({{tr:kulli}}) to the request verb. The relative reading gives the local sense, "what you asked," while the verbal-noun possibility adds a secondary pressure: even the practice of asking belongs inside the gift-and-response relation.

topics.headline: relative pronoun defines the scope
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the gift-field is defined through human request rather than left as an unspecified totality.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as a relative pronoun, attachment evidence makes it the construct complement and object of the following request verb.

topics.headline: verbal-noun reading adds asking-as-domain pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the wording can also make the act of asking itself part of the provision relationship, while local syntax still favors the relative reading.
topics.reason: The rows preserve a valid ambiguity, but the local attachment as object of the request verb keeps the relative reading primary.

words.gloss_range: completed plural asking directed to God, spanning request, petition, and demand in a responsive gift frame
words.root_gloss_range: asking, questioning, petitioning, begging, and demanding; the local Form I perfect selects directed request to God
words.prose: {{ar:سَأَلْتُمُوهُ}} ({{tr:saʾaltumūhu}}) compresses requesters and requested party into one long form: the human plural asks, and the final suffix points to God. The root range lets the asking run from question to petition or urgent demand, but the local Form I keeps it a directed request rather than mutual interrogation. This request beat also leans forward into the next prayer scene, where a concrete voice asks God (14:35), and it prepares the later shift from addressed petitioners to the generic human under verdict.

topics.headline: fused request relation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word fuses human asking and divine addressee into one compact request relation.
topics.reason: The verb is a perfect 2mp form with a 3ms object suffix, and attachment evidence links the relative object to what is requested.

topics.headline: request spans question, petition, and demand
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the provision answers a broad range of human dependence, from asking to urgent petition, while the local verb remains directed request.
topics.reason: Dictionary pressure broadens the register, but the local Form I perfect and suffix select a directed request to God.

topics.headline: asking bridges to provision and later prayer
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that universal human asking is not isolated; it anticipates the next concrete prayer voice (14:35).
topics.reason: Same-surah and boundary rows connect the ask-and-give pattern here with later prayer language.

topics.headline: petitioners become subject of later verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the movement from addressed petitioners to the later generic human verdict.
topics.reason: The request verb is second-person plural, while the tail of the ayah turns to a third-person species noun.

words.gloss_range: connector that joins the completed grant to the conditional counting test
words.prose: The second {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) resets the beat without severing the sequence. It turns the completed grant into an attempted audit: what has just been given is now tested by the impossible condition of counting it.

topics.headline: connector into the counting condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the counting clause is the immediate continuation of the grant, not a new topic.
topics.reason: The particle introduces the conditional unit and coordinates it with the preceding provision clause.

words.gloss_range: conditional particle that makes the counting attempt hypothetical and governs the jussive response frame
words.prose: {{ar:إِنْ}} ({{tr:ʾin}}) turns counting into a tested scenario rather than an expected achievement. It governs the jussive counting verb and sets up the answer in negation, so the clause grants the attempt for argument's sake while already framing completion as structurally out of reach.

topics.headline: hypothetical conditional frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the text stages counting as a hypothetical test whose successful outcome is not expected.
topics.reason: QAC marks the particle as conditional, and attachment evidence makes the following counting verb the protasis of the conditional.

topics.headline: condition answered by negated completion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the structure is about incommensurability between human counting and divine blessing, not about trying harder.
topics.reason: The protasis-apodosis architecture links the attempted count directly to the negated completion clause.

words.gloss_range: conditional plural attempt to count or enumerate, distinct from exhaustive completion by the next counting verb
words.root_gloss_range: counting, numbering, preparing, and deeming; the local Form I jussive selects enumeration, with preparation and evaluation only as background pressure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: conditional particle governing the hypothetical count frame

words.prose: {{ar:تَعُدُّوا}} ({{tr:taʿuddū}}) gives the humans the attempted action: start counting. The jussive form keeps that action dependent on {{ar:إِنْ}} ({{tr:ʾin}}), and the next verb denies the stronger act of completed enumeration. Root-family senses of preparing or deeming stay in the background: here the ayah tests numerical inventory, then leaves moral assessment to the final verdict. The previous ayah's ceaseless celestial service makes this audit unfinishable, and the same surah later denies human assessment of divine acts from another angle (14:42).

topics.headline: jussive count attempt under the condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that counting is grammatically subordinated as a conditional attempt, not asserted as a completed act.
topics.reason: QAC marks the verb as jussive under the conditional particle, and the lost final nūn is the visible trace of that dependency.

topics.headline: initiated counting answered by failed completion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the two-step drama: humans may begin enumeration, but the stronger completion verb is denied.
topics.reason: The local clause pairs this root with the later exhaustive-count root, distinguishing initial enumeration from completed accounting.

topics.headline: preparation and deeming remain background senses
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the shadow question of whether humans can even prepare for such abundance, while the local sense remains counting.
topics.reason: The broader root range includes preparation and deeming, but the local Form I verb in the conditional count frame selects enumeration.

topics.headline: cosmic provision grounds unfinishable audit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that ceaseless provision from the previous ayah makes the attempted audit unfinishable, with a same-surah reckoning contrast later (14:42).
topics.reason: Boundary evidence connects the count attempt to prior cosmic work, and the same-surah comparison places counting failure near broader assessment language.

words.gloss_range: singular construct blessing as a generic divine favor-field, object of attempted and failed enumeration
words.root_gloss_range: softness, ease, livestock or concrete goods, prosperity, felicity, and blessing; the local noun selects divine favor with material ease still felt
words.prose: {{ar:نِعْمَتَ}} ({{tr:niʿmata}}) is singular but not small: in construct with the divine name it compresses the whole blessing-field into one sourced category. It is the object humans try to count and the antecedent of the later feminine suffix, so one blessing-field undergoes both attempted enumeration and failed completion. The root's softness, comfort, and prosperity field keeps the favor concrete rather than abstract, and the phrase echoes the incalculability formula (16:18).

topics.headline: generic singular blessing in construct
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that one singular noun gathers the many provisions into a sourced divine favor-field.
topics.reason: QAC marks the noun as accusative construct before the divine name, and the CRITICAL rows identify the singular as generic.

topics.headline: one blessing-field under two counting verbs
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same blessing is first the object of counting and then the object that cannot be exhaustively completed.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the noun the object of the count verb, and the later suffix refers back to it.

topics.headline: softness and comfort make blessing concrete
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that blessing here means lived ease and concrete welfare, not a thin abstraction.
topics.reason: The local noun is abstract blessing, while the root family gives material texture through softness, comfort, and prosperity.

topics.headline: formula of uncountable divine blessing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this phrase belongs to a recurring formula for divine favor that defeats enumeration (16:18).
topics.reason: The row family identifies the phrase with the cross-surah incalculability formula and same-surah blessing scenes (14:6; 14:28).

words.gloss_range: genitive divine proper name sourcing and determining the blessing in the construct phrase
words.root_gloss_range: deity, worship, and disputed awe or bewilderment derivations around the divine name; locally the proper name marks God as source and possessor of the blessing
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:Allāhi}}) fixes the blessing's provenance before the inability to count is announced. As the genitive second term of the construct, the proper name makes the favor determinate and divine, not generic benefit. Its joined recitation keeps the blessing heard as attached to the divine name before negation arrives. The derivation dispute adds awe-pressure that fits the failed enumeration, while the phrase also recalls remembered favor (14:6), exchanged favor (14:28), and the incalculability formula (16:18).

topics.headline: divine name sources the blessing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the uncountable blessing is grammatically tied to God before human incapacity is stated.
topics.reason: QAC marks the proper noun as genitive in the construct chain, and attachment evidence identifies it as the complement of the blessing noun.

topics.headline: proper name carries worship and awe pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that failed counting happens before a named divine source, with awe and worship pressure behind the name.
topics.reason: The local function is the divine proper name in genitive position; derivational disputes remain semantic pressure, not a replacement of the proper-name function.

topics.headline: divine source threaded through provision and covering
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same divine-source phrase links remembrance, uncountability, and the later accusation of covering across the surah (14:6; 14:28) and across the formula (16:18).
topics.reason: The rows link the divine name with blessing, covering, same-surah provision scenes, and the repeated incalculability formula.

topics.headline: provenance named before failed enumeration
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the order: source is named before inability, so the failure is a failure before known provenance.
topics.reason: The word is placed between the blessing noun and the negated completion clause, making divine provenance the immediate lead-in to human inability.

words.gloss_range: negation of exhaustive completion in the conditional answer, stating standing inability rather than past-only or future-only failure
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) is where the conditional attempt turns into categorical non-completion. It does not deny that humans may start counting; it denies the outcome of exhaustive enumeration, making the failed tally the formal answer to the condition.

topics.headline: negated apodosis denies exhaustive completion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the failure is placed on completion, not on the mere attempt to count.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as a negative particle before the imperfect verb, and attachment evidence places the phrase as the apodosis of the condition.

words.gloss_range: negated Form IV exhaustive enumeration of the blessing, with the feminine suffix returning to the singular blessing noun
words.root_gloss_range: counting by enclosing, reckoning, census-like enumeration, and possible pebble-counting imagery; the local Form IV selects exhaustive completion by count
words.prose: {{ar:تُحْصُوهَا}} ({{tr:tuḥṣūhā}}) names the count that cannot close. The attached feminine suffix returns to the singular blessing, while the Form IV verb is stronger than starting a tally: it is exhaustive enclosure by counting. The underlying tally image makes the impossible audit feel like reducing blessing to countable units, an operation the verse refuses. That is why the two counting roots matter; humans may begin enumeration, but this specialized completion verb is negated. The phrase repeats the incalculability formula (16:18), and the previous ayah's ongoing celestial service helps explain why a bounded tally cannot close.

topics.headline: suffix returns to the singular blessing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the object of failed completion is the same singular blessing-field named just before.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the suffix as the direct object referring to the blessing phrase.

topics.headline: specialized exhaustive-count verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denied action is technical completion of a count, not casual awareness or partial numbering.
topics.reason: The verb is Form IV and appears in a specialized exhaustive-count row family.

topics.headline: physical tally image behind abstraction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the impossible audit is pictured as reducing blessing to countable units, an operation the verse refuses.
topics.reason: Pebble and cutting imagery remain image-pressure behind the exhaustive reckoning sense; they do not replace the local count-completion meaning.

topics.headline: two-step counting failure and formula recurrence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the local escalation from beginning a count to failing to complete it, reinforced by the repeated formula (16:18).
topics.reason: The word answers the earlier counting verb and participates in the cross-surah formula of uncountable divine blessing.

topics.headline: ceaseless provision grounds failed enumeration
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices why the audit fails: the prior provision field is not static enough for a bounded human tally.
topics.reason: Boundary evidence links the failed exhaustive count to the ongoing cosmic provision of the previous ayah.

words.gloss_range: emphatic assertion particle launching an independent nominal verdict after the conditional count fails
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:ʾinna}}) changes the mode from conditional test to asserted verdict. After the failed audit, the particle governs the human subject and its predicates, making the final clause an emphatic nominal judgment rather than another hypothetical result.

topics.headline: emphatic nominal verdict frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final human characterization is asserted with formal emphasis, not merely inferred from failed counting.
topics.reason: QAC marks the particle as governing an accusative subject and predicates, and the row family links it with the later emphatic prefix.

topics.headline: tail generalizes the preceding failure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah turning from a specific provision-and-counting sequence into a general human diagnosis.
topics.reason: The emphatic clause follows the conditional frame as a sentential tail that universalizes the preceding failure.

words.gloss_range: generic definite human species noun as the accusative subject of the emphatic verdict
words.root_gloss_range: humanity, sociability, familiarity, perception, and disputed links to forgetfulness; locally the species noun bears the final moral predicates

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: emphatic assertion particle governing the final verdict clause

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ}} ({{tr:al-ʾinsāna}}) turns the addressed recipients into the species under verdict. The definite singular is generic, and as the subject of {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:ʾinna}}) it receives both final predicates. Root-family pressure makes the irony sharper: the being associated with familiarity or perception, and in a disputed derivation with forgetfulness, becomes the one who fails to keep divine provision visible. The noun also previews later human scenes, especially the concrete wrongdoers begging for respite (14:44).

topics.headline: generic species subject of the verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verdict is species-wide, not limited to the immediate addressees.
topics.reason: QAC marks the noun as definite and accusative after the emphatic particle, and the rows identify the definiteness as generic.

topics.headline: one human subject bears both predicates
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same human subject who cannot count is now made to bear both intensive moral predicates.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the noun the complement of the emphatic particle and the head of the following predications.

topics.headline: sociability, perception, and forgetfulness sharpen the irony
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the irony that the perceiving or socially aware human is the one who fails to recognize and preserve the source of blessing.
topics.reason: The local noun means the human species; derivational disputes over familiarity, perception, and forgetfulness remain interpretive pressure.

topics.headline: second-person recipients become third-person species
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the discourse shift from direct beneficiaries to a third-person universal indictment.
topics.reason: The ayah moves from second-person suffixes and verbs to the generic human noun in the final clause.

topics.headline: generic human previews later scenes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this generic noun previews later human scenes in the surah, including the concrete wrongdoers who beg for respite (14:44).
topics.reason: The row family links this generic species verdict with later human references in the same surah.

words.gloss_range: emphatic prefix attached to the first predicate inside the final assertion frame

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: emphatic assertion particle opening the final verdict frame

words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) shows that the emphasis opened by {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:ʾinna}}) lands on the characterization itself. Bound to the first intensive predicate, it makes assertion and moral description arrive together rather than leaving emphasis at the clause opener.

topics.headline: emphasis lands on the first predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final verdict is doubly emphasized and that the emphasis attaches directly to the first predicate.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the prefix as emphatic, and the row family shows it functioning with the emphatic opener as a stacked assertion frame.

words.gloss_range: indefinite intensive predicate naming excessive, habitual wronging and misplacement in the final human verdict
words.root_gloss_range: darkness, wrongdoing, injustice, and putting things in the wrong place; locally the intensive form selects habitual excessive wronging with misplacement and darkening pressure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: final intensive predicate of excessive covering and ingratitude

words.prose: {{ar:ظَلُومٌ}} ({{tr:ẓalūmun}}) begins the human diagnosis as a standing quality, not a single event. Its intensive pattern makes wronging habitual and excessive, while the root's darkness and misplacement fields fit the provision logic: blessing is received, then placed wrongly in use, perception, or attribution. Its indefinite cadence pairs audibly with the final predicate, and the word gathers the surah's injustice line (14:1, 14:13, 14:22, 14:27, 14:42) into the species verdict. The predicate also forms a rare paired verdict with {{ar:كَفَّارٌ}} ({{tr:kaffārun}}), binding wronging to covering at the ayah's close.

topics.headline: first intensive predicate of the verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the human is described by an excessive disposition rather than a one-time act.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as an intensive adjective and attachment evidence makes it a predicate of the human subject.

topics.headline: darkness and misplacement color wronging
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that wronging here includes obscuring and misplacing received blessing, not only generic injustice.
topics.reason: The local sense is the moral predicate, while root-family darkness and misplacement give it provision-specific texture.

topics.headline: rare paired verdict with final predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the two adjacent intensive predicates function as a compact formula joining misplacement and covering.
topics.reason: The evidence marks the adjacent pair as distinctive and locally binds the two predicates as one closing verdict.

topics.headline: surah-local injustice thread becomes species predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the surah's injustice thread is gathered into a final diagnosis of the human species.
topics.reason: The rows connect the root with same-surah injustice scenes and with the provision-to-verdict movement.

topics.headline: indefinite quality and audible pairing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the indefinite cadence makes the predicate a quality assigned to the generic human and pairs it audibly with the final word.
topics.reason: The tanwīn and intensive adjective class support quality-predicate force and prepare the parallel cadence with the next predicate.

words.gloss_range: final intensive predicate naming excessive covering, ingratitude, and denial as the climax of the human verdict
words.root_gloss_range: covering, burying, concealing benefit, ingratitude, denial, and in other derivatives expiation-covering; locally the intensive predicate selects excessive covering of divine benefit and provenance

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: first intensive predicate of excessive wronging and misplacement

words.prose: {{ar:كَفَّارٌ}} ({{tr:kaffārun}}) is the final landing of the ayah. Its form is stronger than a simple agent noun, presenting covering or ingratitude as repeated excess. The root's physical covering image makes the moral charge concrete: after uncountable blessing and failed counting, the human covers benefit and provenance. The expiation side of the root is reversed here: not covering fault, but covering blessing's source. As the second predicate or close predicate-adjective, it locks with {{ar:ظَلُومٌ}} ({{tr:ẓalūmun}}), escalating the verdict from misplaced blessing to buried source. It condenses earlier same-surah covering and rejection scenes (14:7, 14:8, 14:9, 14:13, 14:18, 14:22, 14:28) and contrasts with the explicit prayer address that follows (14:35). Its long final -ār cadence makes the last predicate feel heavier than the prior one.

topics.headline: final intensive predicate and closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah ends on an intensified disposition of covering, not on a neutral label.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as an intensive adjective and attachment evidence permits it as a second predicate describing the human subject.

topics.headline: covering image makes ingratitude concrete
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices ingratitude as source-covering: the received benefit is buried rather than left visible.
topics.reason: The local predicate selects excessive covering or ingratitude; physical covering and related derivatives sharpen that sense without making every derivative locally active.

topics.headline: expiation-covering reverses into source-erasure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a root family able to cover fault is here reversed into covering the provenance of blessing.
topics.reason: The expiation derivative is not the local sense, but it helps show the reversal of covering from repair to erasure.

topics.headline: paired predicates escalate the verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the closing pair distributes the verdict: wronging misplaces blessing, and covering buries its source.
topics.reason: The row family treats the adjacent predicates as a distinctive construction whose morphology escalates from the prior intensive form to this stronger one.

topics.headline: covering anchored in blessing and counting fields
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final covering charge answers both the blessing field and the failed counting field.
topics.reason: Co-occurrence rows link the root with blessing and counting roots, and the local ayah makes that linkage explicit.

topics.headline: same-surah covering thread and next prayer foil
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final source-covering verdict contrasts with the next ayah's explicit prayer address (14:35).
topics.reason: Same-surah rows gather earlier covering and rejection scenes into the final word, while the next ayah opens with prayer as a foil.

topics.headline: final cadence gives heavier closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the indefinite final cadence and long closing sound make the last predicate feel heavier than the preceding one.
topics.reason: The word is indefinite with tanwīn, in a marked intensive form, and closes the ayah acoustically.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The giving verb, the encompassing quantifier, the requested-object clause, and the singular field of divine blessing.
baseline_models.mechanism: Human requests identify needs, but giving proceeds from the giver across an encompassing field; requested objects are therefore an access point into blessing, not its outer boundary.

activation_trace.role: The transfer-and-bestowal branch supplies actual giving and makes the giver, rather than human acquisition, the source of the field.
The encompassing-whole branch gathers diverse grants into a total field rather than a short list.
The requested-object branch supplies articulated need as the recipient-side aperture through which some gifts become recognizable.
The good-condition and benefaction branch names the result as a received state of good, broader than possession of objects.

changed_reading.before: God granted the items people requested.
changed_reading.after: Human requests disclose particular needs within an encompassing giver-originated field of benefaction that exceeds the request-led inventory.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired counting and exhaustive-enumeration verbs followed by the intensive human predicates of misplacement and covering.
baseline_models.mechanism: A recipient tries to reduce an encompassing gift-field to discrete countable units. Failure becomes morally diagnostic when gifts are put into a wrong relation of attribution or use and their gifted character is covered.

activation_trace.role: The counting branch supplies the attempted discrete ledger against which the field is tested.
The exhaustive-enumeration branch raises the standard from noticing gifts to fully containing them in number and knowledge.
The out-of-place branch turns the closing judgment into relational misplacement of what was given, not merely an arithmetic shortfall.
The blessing-covering branch supplies active concealment of benefaction and explains why failed recognition can become ingratitude.

changed_reading.before: Blessings are too numerous to count, and humans are generally ungrateful.
changed_reading.after: The failed count exposes a deeper error: humans inventory gifts as possessions, displace them from their giver and proper use, and cover the very benefaction the ledger cannot contain.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier sequence supplies a practicable response to an impossible inventory: retain blessing in memory, acknowledge its giver, and let a little show its effect. Gratitude participates in increase, whereas universal covering cannot impoverish the self-sufficient giver.

activation_trace.role: The benefaction branch anchors the response problem in the focus field of received good.
The recollection branch supplies active retrieval as a finite alternative to exhaustive enumeration.
The repeated benefaction branch binds remembrance to a concrete divine gift rather than free-floating reflection.
The recognition-and-praise branch supplies the appropriate relational answer to blessing.
The growth branch makes gratitude feed an expanding process rather than close a completed account.
The self-sufficiency branch prevents human acknowledgment from being construed as payment needed by the giver.

structural_cues: 14:5-8 moves from remembering divine days and blessing, through gratitude and increase, to the possibility of everyone covering while God remains self-sufficient.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies remembrance, gratitude, increase, covering, and divine self-sufficiency; I infer that remembrance and gratitude replace total counting as the fitted human response. A live alternative is that these are adjacent duties rather than a direct repair of the focus's counting failure.

changed_reading.before: Because blessing cannot be counted, adequate acknowledgment appears impossible.
changed_reading.after: Totalization is impossible but response is not: remembrance and gratitude register blessing at human scale, and their visible effect is increase rather than a closed ledger.

context_deltas.mechanism: Blessing can arrive as a severed harmful relation: rescue removes recipients from an imposed regime of torment and selective killing. What is given therefore includes released states and prevented harms, which cannot be counted like acquired objects.

activation_trace.role: The bestowal branch anchors deliverance as a possible mode of what reaches the recipient.
The good-condition branch allows blessing to be a changed condition, not only a transferred object.
The contextual benefaction branch explicitly labels the rescue sequence as blessing.
The release-by-separation branch supplies removal from oppression as the causal form of that blessing.

structural_cues: 14:6 pairs the command to remember divine blessing with rescue from a household imposing torment, killing sons, and preserving women.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit blessing-rescue pairing and a separation branch; I infer that subtracting a destructive relation counts as giving a good condition. The alternative is that rescue is one historical blessing without defining the focus's wider gift field.

changed_reading.before: The verse concerns an uncountable stock of positive things supplied to people.
changed_reading.after: The uncountable field also includes freedoms, rescues, and harms no longer imposed: gifts can be state transitions and absences, not inventory units.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah stages requests and arrivals whose form and timing remain outside requester control: a demanded authority can be brought only by permission, while a later arrival is punishment at the moment a postponement is sought. The focus cannot therefore promise automatic fulfillment of every uttered demand.

activation_trace.role: The asking-and-seeking branch anchors the model in the focus's requester side.
The bringing branch supplies a concrete human demand for an authority to be produced.
The same bringing branch repeats the demanded act while relocating its possibility away from the messengers' control.
The authorization branch supplies the governing condition that interrupts demand-to-delivery automaticity.
The calamity-arrival branch gives arrival a negative valence at the scene of a belated plea for postponement.

structural_cues: 14:10 demands a clear authority, 14:11 conditions bringing it on divine permission, and 14:44 places a request for delay after punishment has arrived.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a demand, a permission limit, and a late plea under an adverse arrival; I infer that the focus describes provision across requested need rather than requester sovereignty over every demand. The alternative is that the focus refers only to requests that were in fact granted, leaving ungranted requests outside its relative clause.

changed_reading.before: Every request people utter is granted as asked.
changed_reading.after: People receive from across the field of what they ask, but asking does not command the giver, guarantee every object, or control the time and form of arrival.

context_deltas.mechanism: A stable root supports recurring output, while descending water, fruiting, flow, and persistent motion form replenishing supply chains. Giving is thus not a one-time pile but maintained generativity whose current products reveal only part of the operating system.

activation_trace.role: The growth-and-yield branch makes the focus giving verb capable of carrying productive output rather than only handover.
The root-and-base branch supplies the hidden support from which repeated visible benefit can emerge.
The persistence branch makes the productive base durable across outputs.
The yield branch directly turns giving into recurrent fruit production.
The appointed-time branch supplies recurrence, so outputs are temporally renewed rather than simultaneously stockpiled.
The delivery-downward branch supplies water entering the production chain from beyond the recipients.
The ripe-fruit branch supplies a consumable output generated from the prior water-and-growth sequence.
The flowing-movement branch joins transport and rivers to a provision system that works through circulation.
The persistent-striving branch supplies uninterrupted operation at the scale of sun and moon.

structural_cues: 14:24-25 presents a fixed-rooted tree giving produce at every time.
14:32-33 sequences descending water, extracted fruit-provision, moving ships and rivers, and persistently operating sun, moon, night, and day immediately before the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a rooted recurring yield and a chain of water, fruit, movement, and persistent cycles; I infer that these are coupled provisioning infrastructure whose outputs instantiate the focus's giving. A live alternative is that the tree and cosmic list are independent examples rather than one integrated system.

changed_reading.before: God handed over a very large collection of discrete goods.
changed_reading.after: God gives maintained generative arrangements whose rooted, flowing, and timed outputs keep arriving; listing present fruits cannot enumerate the systems that produce them.

context_deltas.mechanism: Misplacement and covering are not merely failures to notice. A replacement operation can install covering where blessing stood, then carry a group into ruin; the human predicates describe active conversion and social rerouting of gifts.

activation_trace.role: The benefaction branch supplies the good field subjected to human handling.
The out-of-place branch supplies the displacement operation linking received good to a wrong destination.
The blessing-covering branch anchors the final intensive predicate in active concealment of gift.
The substitution branch supplies the causal operation by which one response is placed where another reality stood.
The contextual benefaction branch identifies the displaced term as the same divine gift field named in the focus.
The contextual blessing-covering branch identifies what is installed in the gift's place.

structural_cues: 14:28 states a blessing-to-covering replacement and immediately links its agents to settling their people in an abode of ruin.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies substitution, blessing, covering, and a communal destination; I infer a causal chain from handling gifts wrongly to rerouting a people. The alternative is that substitution categorizes their response without implying that blessing itself is materially transformed.

changed_reading.before: The closing predicates say that individuals passively fail to appreciate many gifts.
changed_reading.after: The human can actively relocate and cover blessing, installing an anti-response in its place and transmitting the resulting destination socially.

context_deltas.mechanism: A request can open a distributed answer: secure place, protected worship, human attachment, fruit provision, descendants, accepted practice, and forgiveness span social, ecological, temporal, and spiritual domains. Giving from what is asked is a responsive relation, not an object-for-utterance exchange.

activation_trace.role: The requested-need branch anchors the contextual prayers as disclosures of desired good.
The apportioned-provision branch supplies material support requested inside a barren setting.
The gift-without-counterpayment branch identifies late-life descendants as gratuitous giving rather than earned exchange.
The hearing branch places prayer at the received end of a relationship without requiring instant visible fulfillment.
The calling branch supplies prayer as directed speech that bends attention toward the giver.
The willing-acceptance branch adds reception of prayer itself to the requested field.
The repeated calling branch extends request from provisions to durable worship and accepted relation.

structural_cues: 14:35-41 unfolds requests for security, separation from idols, worship across descendants, human hearts, fruit provision, accepted prayer, and forgiveness.
14:37 places provision inside a valley without cultivation, while 14:39 names children given in old age and a Lord who hears prayer.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a prayer sequence, a barren setting, social attraction, provision, late-life gift, hearing, and acceptance; I infer that answers operate as an interdependent ecology across time. The alternative is that each prayer and gift remains a separate example rather than one model of the focus clause.

changed_reading.before: A request names an item and giving supplies that same item.
changed_reading.after: Requests disclose needs whose answers can unfold as interdependent conditions, relationships, capacities, and delayed gifts across generations.

context_deltas.mechanism: The recipient cannot close the ledger on incoming benefaction, yet divine accounting loses neither wrong action nor any soul's acquisition. The surah reverses the scale: gifts overflow human enumeration while deeds remain fully answerable.

activation_trace.role: The counting branch supplies the failed human-side ledger of incoming good.
The exhaustive-enumeration branch marks the precise operation recipients cannot complete.
The account branch supplies a later day on which reckoning stands rather than fails.
The supposition branch exposes human reckoning as liable to mistake delayed justice for divine neglect.
The lapse-outside-awareness branch supplies exactly the omission denied of divine attention to wrongdoing.
The act-for-recompense branch turns the later account into matched consequence rather than mere recordkeeping.
The encompassing-whole branch closes the scope around every soul, contrasting the recipient's failed totalization.
The acquisition branch supplies the outgoing human side whose actions and gains remain attributable.
The rapid-account branch completes the reversal with efficient divine reckoning.

structural_cues: 14:41 says the account will stand, 14:42 denies divine inattention to what wrongdoers do, and 14:51 pairs every soul's acquisition with rapid account.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed human enumeration of blessing and later exhaustive, non-negligent accounting of deeds; I infer a deliberate asymmetry between incoming gift and outgoing action. The alternative is that the two accounting registers are thematically adjacent without functioning as a direct reversal.

changed_reading.before: Counting fails simply because blessings are very numerous.
changed_reading.after: The failure is one-sided: recipients cannot close the account on incoming benefaction, but no acquired action exits the giver's comprehensive and consequential account.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the packet's non-dominant mapped target for the asking root and joins it to water-channel imagery. It remains anchored in the focus's asking, giving, and enumeration sequence and in the packet's explicit mapped branch plus nearby water and river cues. Downstream prose should mark it as a spatial metaphor, not replace the ordinary sense of asking with an extraction etymology.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The asking form's split mapped inventory, the giving verb's channel branch, and the failed exhaustive count.

activation_trace.role: The gentle-extraction branch makes a request imageable as drawing a visible portion out of a larger source.
The directed-watercourse branch supplies a conduit through which provision reaches recipients.
The exhaustive-enumeration branch marks why samples drawn from a conduit cannot contain the whole supplying system.
The water branch supplies the material moving through the nearby provision sequence.
The flowing branch extends the conduit model from a delivered portion to ongoing circulation.
The earth-cutting river branch supplies a large channel whose effects exceed any one withdrawal.

changed_reading.before: Requests form a list, and grants answer entries on that list.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, requests draw recognizable portions from a flowing provision network, while the channel, source, and downstream effects exceed what any recipient extracts or enumerates.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links a moral root image in the focus to a later material scene of clothing and over-covering. It remains valid as a spatial reversal because the focus inventory explicitly supplies both generic covering and covering blessing, while 14:50 supplies garments and a cover over faces. Downstream prose should present the reversal as a surah-level resonance, not claim lexical identity or a stated one-to-one punishment mechanism.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The intensive closing predicate whose branch inventory includes both covering generally and covering blessing.

activation_trace.role: The generic-covering branch supplies the spatial action latent in the human predicate.
The blessing-covering branch fixes that spatial action to the focus's received benefaction.
The substitution branch supplies the intermediate reversal by placing covering where blessing stood.
The human-worn garment branch gives the closing scene an imposed layer around the body.
The overlying-cover branch reverses agency as an external covering comes upon the faces of those in the final scene.

changed_reading.before: The final focus predicate is only an abstract label for ingratitude.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the one who repeatedly covers blessing is carried toward a scene of being clothed and over-covered, reversing the direction and agency of covering.

strongest_changes: Uncountability redirects the recipient from exhaustive inventory to remembrance and gratitude, whose effect is increase rather than account closure.
Giving expands from discrete objects to rescues, relationships, and maintained provisioning systems with recurring outputs.
The surah sharply reverses the ledger: incoming benefaction exceeds human enumeration, while every outgoing human acquisition remains divinely accounted.
The closing predicates become active operations: blessing can be misplaced, covered, and socially rerouted rather than merely overlooked.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context repeatedly reactivates the focus's lexical axes through functional reversals: request is limited by permission yet unfolded through prayer, gift becomes rooted and flowing process, blessing is substituted with covering, and failed human enumeration is answered by rapid divine account.
remaining_uncertainties: The construction about what was asked may range over granted request classes rather than every uttered demand; the context rules out requester control but does not fully settle that grammar.
The extraction-and-channel outlier depends on a packet-supplied split mapped target and should remain exploratory.
The rooted tree and the water-cosmic sequence may be independent analogies rather than one integrated provisioning system.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The failure is not arithmetic but enclosure.** `ع د د` `B001` enumerates; `ح ص ي` `B002` counts until encompassed, against `ك ل ل` `B003` totality and `ن ع م` `B001` favor. The prior chain expands from water to celestial time, and later hidden/open knowledge encompasses earth and sky. I infer favors exceed the boundary required to turn counting into total grasp. “You cannot enumerate” reads as inability to enclose a network, not merely a very large list.

2. **Human visibility can conceal the system that sustains it.** `ء ن س` `B001` presents visible human presence, `ظ ل م` `B004` puts something in the wrong place, and `ك ف ر` `B004` covers favor. I infer the human relocates received goods into the category of self-produced possession, thereby covering their chain of arrival. The closing description reads as structural misallocation joined to ingratitude.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Ayah 14:38 supplied the exact asymmetry: humans cannot enclose favors by counting, while no thing in earth or sky escapes divine knowledge.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Grant and request form a response arc.** `ء ت ي B002` supplies granting or bringing, and `س ء ل B001` asking. The prior ayat enumerate supplied systems; 14:37 asks for fruit in a barren valley, and 14:39 identifies children in old age as a gift followed by praise and heard prayer. The packet supplies request, grant, and recognition; I infer a responsive relation rather than indiscriminate acquisition. `ءَاتَاكُم مِّن كُلِّ مَا سَأَلْتُمُوه` reads as provision meeting articulated need within a larger gift system.
2. **Counting fails at enclosure, not at the first numeral.** `ع د د B001` supplies enumerating, while `ح ص ي B002` supplies counting until the object is encompassed. The water-transport-celestial sequence of 14:32-33 is a network whose outputs and dependencies exceed itemization; 14:37-39 add settlement, attraction, fruit, lineage, and answered prayer. I infer that humans may enumerate instances but cannot close a boundary around the whole. `لَا تُحْصُوهَا` reads as failure of systemic enclosure rather than inability to name any favors.
3. **Human wrong withholds and covers a circulating gift.** `ظ ل م B008` supplies prevention and withholding, and `ك ف ر B004` covering over a favor. The preceding command in 14:31 sends allotted provision outward as expenditure, while 14:32-34 display a supply chain meant to reach beneficiaries. The packet supplies flow and the paired human dispositions; I infer that `ظَلُوم` blocks distribution while `كَفَّار` blocks recognition. The closing diagnoses two closures of one provision circuit.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 14:37's request for fruit and 14:39's gifted sons plus heard prayer made the grant-request arc concrete. They also expanded the uncountable network from material supply into settlement, attraction, lineage, and response.

baseline.text: Size istediğiniz her şeyden vermiştir. Allah'ın nimetlerini saymaya kalksanız onları sayamazsınız. İnsan gerçekten çok zalim ve çok nankördür.

findings.text: Sayımın başarısızlığı ilk rakamda değil, birbirine bağlı nimet ağının çevresini bütünüyle kapatamamadadır.
İnsanın zulmü nimetin başkasına akışını tutar, nankörlüğü ise bu akışın kaynağını ve varlığını örter.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Provision reaches life through ordered outward and inward flows: spending, rainfall, fruiting, transport, river courses, celestial cycles, and gifts.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The interval links ritual expenditure to tunnels and outlets, rainfall to delivery, boats to circular motion, dawn to opening, and blessing to an unfinishable account.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Gifts beyond Exhaustive Enumeration
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Requests meet giving across a total field of needs, but the resulting benefits exceed the recipient's capacity to count or close the account.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: giving `quranic:root_000009:B002/m01`; requesting `quranic:root_000661:B001/m01`; totality `quranic:root_001315:B003/m01`; counting `quranic:root_000989:B001/m01`; exhaustive enumeration `quranic:root_000332:B002/m01`; blessing `quranic:root_001525:B001/m01`; account and calculation `quranic:root_000318:B001/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 14:34, 41: آتَاكُمْ، كُلِّ، سَأَلْتُمُوهُ، تَعُدُّوا، نِعْمَتَ، لَا تُحْصُوهَا، الْحِسَابُ.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Giving answers asking, yet the total granted field cannot be reduced to a completed inventory. Counting and exhaustive enumeration are activated only to fail, reframing abundance as an account whose entries continue beyond human closure.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynakların tümü, yağmurun düştüğü başka bir yerden yağmur almamış bölgeye ulaşan seli veya kendi yatağında dışarıdan geçip gelen seli tanımlar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım kişi niteleyen kalıpla sınırlıdır; her gelen kişi veya dışarıdan gelen sel bu kapsama alınmaz.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, kişinin bulunduğu topluluğa mensup olmaması ve bu nedenle yabancı sayılması üzerinde birleşir.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal bir topluluk içinde o topluluktan olmayan kişiyi anlatır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi ekin ve hurmanın ürünü, gelişmesi ve bol verimi ile suyun çoğalmasını destekler. Çalkalanan tulumdan yağın çıkması ise yalnız ayrı kalıbın kaynak ifadesiyle açıklanabilen, çekirdeğe bağlı olmayan bir kullanımdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bitkisel ürün ve artış çekirdektir; suyun çoğalması uzantı, tulumdan yağ çıkması ise ayrı kalıp kullanımıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Ürün ve gelişme bildiren biçim, suyun çoğalması ve çalkalanan tulumda yağın belirmesini bildiren kalıptan ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Ekin ve hurmanın gelişip ürün vermesi, ürününün ve veriminin bol olmasıdır; suyun çoğalması da bu artış alanına uzanır. Ayrı bir kalıp, çalkalanan tulumda yağın ortaya çıkmasını bildirir.

facets.statement: Ekin veya hurma gelişir, ürün verir ve verimi artar.
Suyun miktarı çoğalır.
Ayrı bir kalıpta çalkalanan tulumun yağı ortaya çıkar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt bitkisel gelişme, ürün ve bol verimi merkez alır; su artışı ve tulum yağının belirmesi farklı kapsamlı kullanımlardır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Ekin veya hurmanın gelişmesi, ürün çıkarması ve veriminin artması birlikte anlatılacağında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bitkisel gelişme, ürün ve bolluk çekirdeğini korur.

error_profile.loses: Gelişme sürecini, suyun çoğalmasını ve tulum yağı kullanımını dışarıda bırakır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yönetime ödenen vergi veya baş vergisini ortak alan olarak verir ve aynı toplu iddia içinde bir kişiye sunulan rüşvet kullanımını da bildirir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Vergi adı olarak kullanılan biçim ile birine rüşvet vermeyi bildiren kalıp kapsam bakımından ayrılır.

Ayrı bir kullanımda bir kimseye rüşvet verilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yarışın son sınırı, işlek ya da yürünmüş yol, yol kavşağı ve bir evin karşısında veya hizasında olma kullanımlarını açıkça destekler.

Yarış atlarının koşusunun ulaştığı son sınır adlandırılır.
Bir yapı başka bir yapının karşısında veya aynı hizasında bulunur.

error_profile.loses: Yarış sonu ile bir yapının karşısında veya hizasında bulunma kullanımlarını dışarıda bırakır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi belirli kalıplarda kişiye ölüm, ağır hastalık, bela veya kırık gelmesini; malın yok olmasını; kişinin öldürülüp götürülmesini ve düşmanın yaklaşmasını destekler. Genel olarak gelişin iyi veya kötü olabileceği notu, bu dalın yalnız zararlı kalıplarını genişletmez.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnız belirtilen zarar ve tehdit kalıplarına bağlıdır; genel gelme eylemi veya her türlü yok oluş değildir.

concept_map.definition: Bakımı, geçimi veya taşınması başkasının sorumluluğuna yük olan kişi ya da şeydir. Yetim, çocuğu bulunmayan kişi veya hem çocuğu hem de ebeveyni bulunmayan kişi gibi geleneksel adlandırmalar ile akrabaların birine bağımlı hale gelmesi bu çekirdeğe bağlı özel kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Bir kişi ya da şeyin bakım, geçim veya taşıma bakımından başkasına yük olması çekirdektir.
Yetim, çocuğu bulunmayan kişi veya hem çocuğu hem ebeveyni bulunmayan kişi kanıta bağlı özel referanslardır.
Taşınan tapınma nesnesi ve geçimi bir kişiye kalan akrabalar, bağımlılık ilişkisinin söz öbeğine bağlı örnekleridir.
Kaynak anlatımında ağır tabiatlı kişi ve başkası adına iş gören kişi de bu adlandırmanın çevresinde anılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak çekirdek, geçimi veya bakımı bir başkasının üzerinde kalan bağımlı kişi ya da şeydir. Bir kaynak, ağır tabiatlı kişiyi ve başkası adına iş gören kişiyi de bu adlandırma çevresinde anar.

branches.source_phrase_ar: الكُلّ العيال واليتيم (maqayis)؛ الكل اليتيم والكل الرجل الذي لا ولد له والكل أيضا الذي هو عيال وثقل (ayn)؛ الكل العيال والثقل والكل اليتيم والكل الذي لا ولد له ولا والد (sihah)؛ الكل الثقيل الروح واليتيم والوكيل والذي هو عيال وثقل على صاحبه (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, parçaları veya bireyleri eksiksiz kapsayan ve biçimce tekil olsa da toplu anlam veren belirleyiciyi açıkça tanımlar. Dalın bütünlük ve tamlık çerçevesi bu dilbilgisel çekirdeğe uygundur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal bir şeyin olgunlaşıp tamamlanma sürecini değil, var olan bütünün eksiksiz kapsamını bildirir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız yalın kapsam belirleyicisini açıklar; belirli kalıplardan yeni bir temel anlam çıkarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir bütünün parçalarını ya da bir kümenin bireylerini eksiksiz biçimde kapsayan, biçimce tekil olsa da toplu anlam verebilen belirleyicidir.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin parçalarının veya bir kümedeki bireylerin hiçbirini dışarıda bırakmadan kapsanması çekirdektir.
Sözcük biçimce tekil kullanılırken anlamca bir topluluğun tamamına yönelebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, sözcüğün parçaları bir araya getirerek tam kapsam verdiğinde ve tekil biçimle topluluğun bütününü gösterdiğinde birleşir. Bir kaynak, sözcüğü daima tamlanan olarak kullanılan bir kapsam adı şeklinde sınırlar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Parçaların veya bireylerin eksiksiz kapsamını bildiren yalın belirleyici için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Eksiksiz kapsamı ve bütünlük anlamını doğal Türkçe belirleyicilerle korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Tek bir şeyin bütün parçalarının birlikte kastedildiği adlaşmış bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bir şeyin hiçbir parçasını dışarıda bırakmayan tam kapsamı korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Her büyüklükteki kümenin veya bir nesnenin parçalarının tamamını kapsayabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kapsamı özellikle iki öğeyle sınırlıdır ve iki ayrı biçimle kurulur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal belirtilen kümedeki öğeleri eksiksiz kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal sayı bakımından genel bir bütünlük belirleyicisidir; komşu dal yalnız iki öğenin ikisini birden kapsayan özel belirleyicileri anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Var olan parçaların veya bireylerin eksiksiz olarak kapsama alınmasını bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir şeyin gelişip tamamlanması, eksikliğinin giderilmesi veya olgun duruma erişmesi de anlatılır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal eksiksizlik ve tam olma düşüncesinde buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal nicel kapsam kuran bir belirleyicidir; komşu dal ise bir şeyin tamam olma durumu ile tamamlanma eylemini de içerir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tamamı incelendi; sayı bakımından özel kapsam ile tamamlanma durumunu ayıran iki komşu yararlı bulundu, deyimsel bütünlük anlatımları çekirdeği ayrıca keskinleştirmedi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه لفظ الكُلّ لضم الأجزاء وإحاطة الشيء أو الذوات، ومعنى التمام في كل البسط ونحوه
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الكُلّ بمعنى العيال والثقل ولا كلال القوة والحدة
branches.source_phrase_ar: كل اسم موضوع للإحاطة مضاف أبدا (maqayis)؛ كل لفظه واحد ومعناه جمع (sihah)؛ يقع كل على اسم منكور موحد فيؤدي معنى الجماعة وكلهم للإحاطة (tahdhib)؛ لفظ كل هو لضم أجزاء الشيء ويفيد معنى التمام (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, ana baba ve çocuk dışındaki mirasçı yakınları, uzak soy bağını ve doğrudan değil yan koldan geçen mirası birlikte verir. Dal doğru yöndedir; ancak adın ölen kişi, mirasçı topluluğu, akrabalık türü veya miras ilişkisinin kendisi için kullanılabildiği açık tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Ana baba ile çocuk bu sınıfın dışındadır; olumsuz söz öbeği ise yan koldan değil doğrudan hakla miras almayı bildirir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yan kol akrabalığı çekirdeğini korur; doğrudan miras ve uzak kuzenlik okumaları kendi söz öbeklerine bağlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Ana baba ve çocuk dışındaki, özellikle uzak veya yan koldaki yakınlar üzerinden kurulan mirasçılık ve akrabalık ilişkisidir. Ad, böyle bir miras bırakan kişi, bu yolla mirasçı olanlar veya ilişkinin kendisi için kullanılabilir.

facets.statement: Doğrudan üstsoy ve altsoy dışında kalan yan kol veya uzak akrabalık temel sınırdır.
Ad, ana babası ve çocuğu bulunmadan ölen kişiye, onun yan kol mirasçılarına veya bu miras biçimine yönelebilir.
Olumsuz miras söz öbeği doğrudan hakla miras almayı, kuzenlik söz öbeği ise uzak akrabalığı belirtir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım ana baba ve çocuk dışındaki mirasçı yakınları, uzak kuzenleri ve yan koldan geçen mirası bir araya getirir. Sözcüğün ölen kişiye mi, mirasçılara mı, akrabalığa mı yoksa mirasa mı yöneldiği bağlama göre değişebilir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Ana baba ve çocuk dışındaki yakınlar üzerinden kurulan miras ilişkisini açıklamak için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Dışlanan doğrudan soy çizgisini ve yan kol mirasçılığını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ana baba veya çocuk olmayan uzak bir yakının mirasçı olduğu bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Mirasçının doğrudan soy çizgisi dışında bulunmasını açıkça korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yakın kuzen olmayan, soy bağı daha uzaktan kurulan kuzen için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Kuzenlik bağının doğrudan ve yakın olmayan derecesini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: ana baba ve çocuk dışındaki yan kol mirasçılığı
yan koldan değil, doğrudan hakla miras almak

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Akrabalığı ana baba ve çocuk dışındaki yan kollara ve miras bağlamına sınırlar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Her türlü kan ve soy yakınlığını, doğrudan üstsoy ile altsoyu da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal insanlar arasındaki soy bağını ve yakınlık derecesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal miras bağlamında doğrudan üstsoy ve altsoyu dışarıda bırakan özel bir akrabalık sınıfıdır; komşu dal soy yakınlığının tamamını kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Mirasçının doğrudan soy çizgisi dışında bulunma koşulunu öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Malın ölen kişiden herhangi bir yasal veya soy temelli mirasçıya geçmesi olayını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal ölen kişiden kalan malın yakınlara geçmesi alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal belirli bir akraba ve mirasçı sınıfını sınırlar; komşu dal ise mirasın kaynaktan mirasçıya geçmesi olayının genel adıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel akrabalık ve genel miras aktarımı en açıklayıcı iki sınırı verdi, öteki adaylar özel miras hükümleri veya yalnız aynı aile alanındaki uzak konulardır.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الكَلالة للميت أو الوارث أو القرابة التي عدا الوالد والولد، وبنو العم الأباعد، والميراث من عرض لا من قرب مباشر
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الولد والوالد، ولا الإرث عن قرب واستحقاق مباشر
branches.source_phrase_ar: الكلالة هم الرجال الورثة وبنو العم الأباعد ومن مات وليس له ولد ولا والد (maqayis)؛ الكل النسب البعيد (ayn)؛ لم يرثه كلالة أي لم يرثه عن عرض والكلالة بنو العم الأباعد (sihah)؛ الكلالة من القرابة ما خلا الوالد والولد (tahdhib)؛ الكلالة اسم لما عدا الولد والوالد من الورثة (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, bir şeyin başı veya çevresi boyunca kuşatıcı biçimde yer alan nesne ve görünümleri ortaklaştırır. Baş çevresindeki süslü kuşak, gök konumu, çevreleyen bulut ve kenarı çiçek ya da küçük bulutlarla sarılı yer bu çekirdeğin destekli uzantılarıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, çevreleme biçimini temel alır; dikilmiş koruyucu perde veya genel bütünlük belirleyicisi değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın adın çevreleyen nesne anlamları korunur; çiçekle veya bulut parçalarıyla çevrilme yalnız verilen niteleme kalıplarına bağlanır.

concept_map.definition: Bir başın, yerin ya da göksel görünümün çevresini kuşak gibi saran veya kenarlarını belirginleştiren nesne ve oluşumdur. Süslü baş kuşağı, belirli bir gök konumu, çevreleyen bulut ve çiçek ya da küçük bulutlarla çevrilmiş görünüm bu çekirdeğin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin çevresini kuşak gibi sarma veya kenarını çevreleyerek belirginleştirme çekirdektir.
Süslü baş kuşağı veya taç ile belirli bir gök konumu, yalın adın özel karşılıklarıdır.
Bir yeri dolaşan bulut ya da başka bir örtümsü bulut görünümü çevreleme çekirdeğinin göğe uzanmasıdır.
Çiçeklerle çevrili çayır ve çevresinde küçük bulut parçaları bulunan bulut, belirli niteleme kalıplarıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar başı saran süslü kuşağı, belirli gök konumunu ve çevreleme biçimi gösteren bulut ile çayır tasvirlerini aynı çevresini sarma düşüncesinde toplar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Baş, yer veya göksel görünüm çevresinde kuşatıcı bir sınır oluşturan dal çekirdeğine uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Çevreleme ilişkisini ve kuşak biçimli görünümü birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Başı çevreleyen süslü kuşak veya değerli taşlarla bezeli başlık bağlamına uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Başı saran süslü başlık anlamını doğal ve kısa biçimde korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ana bulutun çevresinde daha küçük bulut parçalarının bulunduğu görünüm için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Merkezdeki bulutu ve onu çevreleyen parçaları birlikte korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: Ay'ın konaklarından biri, Akrep takımyıldızının başı
bir yerin çevresini dolaşan örtümsü bulut
çevresi küçük bulut parçalarıyla sarılı bulut

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Süslü baş kuşağı, belirli gök konumu ve bulut çevrelenmesi gibi özel adlandırmaları kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Boyun halkası, değirmen parçası ve çeşitli dairesel nesneler gibi daha geniş halka kullanımları vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal bir şeyin çevresine dolanan halka veya kuşak biçimini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal çevreleme biçimini belirli taç ve gök görünümlerinde adlaştırır; komşu dal ise boyun çevresindeki ve başka nesnelerdeki halkayı daha genel ele alır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Çevreleyen nesne veya görünümün kendisini ve ondan türeyen özel adları belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir topluluğun bir kişi ya da nesnenin çevresini alması eylemini de anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal bir merkezin çevresinde halka oluşturma düşüncesini paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal çoğunlukla çevreleyen kuşağın veya göksel görünümün adıdır; komşu dal çevresini alma ve kuşatma eylemini öne çıkarır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün çevreleme adayları gözden geçirildi; halka biçimli nesne ile çevresini alma eylemi en yararlı iki karşılaştırmadır, diğerleri yalnız aynı uzamsal alanda kalan özel nesnelerdir.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الإكليل، وإطافة الشيء بالرأس أو بالمكان، ومنزل القمر، والسحاب المحيط، والروضة المحفوفة بالنور، والسحاب المكلل بالقطع
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الكَلالة في أحكام الميراث إلا من جهة أصل الإحاطة، ولا يدخل فيه الكِلّة السترية بوصفها بيتا مخيطا
branches.source_phrase_ar: إطافة شيء بشيء والإكليل منزل من منازل القمر والسحاب يدور بالمكان (maqayis)؛ الإكليل شبه عصابة مزينة بالجواهر والإكليل من منازل القمر وروضة مكللة حفت بالنور (ayn)؛ الإكليل شبه عصابة ويسمى التاج إكليلا والإكليل منزل والسحاب كأن غشاء ألبسه وروضة مكللة وسحاب مكلل (sihah)؛ الغمام المكلل السحابة تكون حولها قطع والإكليل شبه عصابة والإكليل منزل (tahdhib)؛ الإكليل سمي بذلك لإطافته بالرأس (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, ince kumaştan dikilip küçük bir ev gibi kurulan böcek koruyucu örtüyü açıkça verir; mezarlar üzerine küçük yapı, kubbe veya kule yükseltme kullanımı da aynı biçim benzerliğiyle eklenir. Bu ikinci kullanım temel nesnenin kendisiyle özdeşleştirilmemelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek dikilmiş koruyucu örtüdür; mezar yapısı, yalnız ona benzeyen yükseltilmiş yapı kalıbındaki uzantıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın ad dikilmiş ince örtüyü bildirir; mezar üstüne yapı yükseltme anlamı yalnız belirtilen söz öbeğinde geçerlidir.

concept_map.definition: Sivrisinek veya tahtakurusu gibi böceklerden korunmak için ince kumaştan dikilip küçük bir ev gibi kurulan örtüdür. Mezar üzerine buna benzeyen küçük kule veya kubbe biçimli yapı yükseltmek, söz öbeğine bağlı bir uzantıdır.

facets.statement: İnce kumaştan dikilen ve küçük bir ev gibi kurulabilen koruyucu örtü temel nesnedir.
Örtünün sivrisinek ve tahtakurusu gibi böceklere karşı korunma amacı vardır.
Mezarın üzerine küçük kule veya kubbe benzeri yapı yükseltmek, biçim benzerliğine dayalı söz öbeği uzantısıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak nesnesi, böceklerden korunmak için ince kumaştan dikilen ev biçimli örtüdür. Mezar üzerinde küçük yapı veya kubbe yükseltme, bu biçimden hareket eden özel bir yapı kullanımını oluşturur.

concept_gloss.applicability: İnce kumaştan dikilen ve böceklerden korunmak için kurulan temel nesneye uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Örtünün biçimini, malzeme niteliğini ve koruma işlevini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Uyuyan kişiyi sivrisinek ve benzeri böceklerden koruyan kumaş örtü bağlamında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Böceklerden koruyan yatak çevresi örtüsünü doğal Türkçe adıyla korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Mezar üzerinde küçük kule veya kubbe benzeri yapı yükseltme söz öbeği için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yapının mezar üzerinde yükseltilmesini ve kubbemsi biçimini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: böceklerden koruyan ev biçimli ince örtü, cibinlik
mezar üzerine küçük kule veya kubbe biçimli yapı yükseltmek

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: İnce kumaştan dikilip ev gibi kurulur ve özellikle böceklere karşı korur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Her türlü örtme, gizlenme ve örtü nesnesini biçim veya amaç sınırlaması olmadan kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal bir şeyi kumaş veya benzeri engelle örterek koruma alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal biçimi dikilmiş küçük eve benzeyen ve böceklere karşı kullanılan özel örtüdür; komşu dal örtme ve gizlenmenin genel alanıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kişinin çevresine kurulan bütün bir koruyucu örtü düzenini belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Çadırın yalnız arka bölümünü oluşturan dikilmiş bir veya iki kumaş parçasıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal dikilmiş kumaş parçalarının küçük ev veya çadır düzeninde kullanılmasını paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal böceklere karşı çevreleyen bağımsız koruyucu örtüdür; komşu dal çadırın belirli bir bölümünü kapatan yapı parçasıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün örtü ve yapı adayları incelendi; genel örtme ile çadırın dikilmiş özel parçası sınırı açıklar, diğer adaylar işlev veya yapı bakımından daha uzaktır.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الكِلّة غشاء أو ستر رقيق يخاط كالبيت للوقاية من البعوض والبق، وما يشبه الصوامع والقباب في تكليل القبور
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الإكليل الذي يحيط بالرأس، ولا الكُلّ بمعنى الجميع
branches.source_phrase_ar: الكلة غشاء من ثوب يتوقى به من البعوض (ayn)؛ الكلة الستر الرقيق يخاط كالبيت يتوقى فيه من البق (sihah)؛ الكلة من الستور ما خيط فصار كالبيت والتكليل رفعها ببناء مثل الكلل وهي الصوامع والقباب (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynaklar iki ses biçimini de göğüs karşılığı olarak doğrudan ve tutarlı biçimde verir. Dalın beden bölgesi kimliği ek bir işlem, nitelik veya mecaz gerektirmez.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal yalnız göğüs bölgesini adlandırır; kısa ve kalın erkek nitelemesiyle topluluk anlamındaki çoğul biçim ayrı dallardır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın beden bölgesi adını verir ve niteleme ya da söz öbeği anlamı eklemez.

concept_map.definition: İnsan veya hayvan bedeninin boyun ile karın arasında kalan ön üst bölümü, yani göğüstür.

facets.statement: Bedenin ön üst bölümündeki göğüs bölgesinin adı olması tek ve doğrudan çekirdektir.
Aynı beden bölgesi iki yakın ses biçimiyle adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Bütün kaynak anlatımları sözcüğü doğrudan göğüs bölgesinin adı olarak verir; bir kaynak yakın sesli ikinci biçimi de aynı anlamla kaydeder.

concept_gloss.applicability: İnsan veya hayvan bedeninin boyun altındaki ön üst bölgesini adlandıran bütün kullanımlara uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Beden bölgesi kimliğini kısa ve doğrudan biçimde eksiksiz korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Beden bölümünün konumunu açıkça belirtmenin gerektiği açıklayıcı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Anatomik bölgenin göğüs olduğunu açık ve eksiksiz biçimde korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yalnız göğüs bölgesinin yalın adı olarak sınırlandırılmıştır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Göğsün üst çıkıntısı, rahatsızlıkları, örtüleri, işaretleri ve güce dayalı adlandırmaları da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal insan veya hayvan bedeninin göğüs bölgesini doğrudan adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal yalnız beden bölgesi adıdır; komşu dal aynı bölgeyi merkez alarak hastalık, örtü, işaret ve niteleme gibi ilişkili kullanımlara da açılır.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Göğüs ile karın sınırında öne çıkan belirli bir kemiği anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal göğüs anatomisi alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal geniş beden bölgesinin adıdır; komşu dal o bölgede yer alan belirli bir kemik yapısını adlandırır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tamamı değerlendirildi; genel göğüs dalı ile belirli göğüs kemiği, bütün-parça sınırını en iyi gösterdi, diğer anatomik adaylar daha uzak bölümlerdir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, erkek için kısa boy, kalınlık, güç ve toplu beden yapısını birlikte verir. Dal bu nitelikleri tek bir yapı betimlemesi olarak doğru biçimde korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu anlam yalnız erkek niteleyen söz öbeğinde geçerlidir; göğüs adı veya topluluk adı olarak genelleştirilemez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım açıkça erkek niteleyen söz öbeğine bağlıdır ve sözcüğe bağımsız bir temel anlam yüklemez.

concept_map.definition: Bir erkeği çok uzun olmayan, kısa ya da orta boylu; kalın, güçlü ve bedeni toplu yapılı olarak niteleyen söz öbeğidir.

facets.statement: Erkeğin kısa veya çok uzun olmayan boyu ile kalın ve güçlü beden yapısı birlikte belirtilir.
Bedenin dağınık değil toplu, sıkı ve derli toplu görünmesi nitelemenin tamamlayıcı yönüdür.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar erkek nitelemesinde kısa ya da çok uzun olmayan boyu, kalınlığı, gücü ve toplu beden yapısını bir arada verir.
